text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis statement in the introduction","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a recognizable controlling idea and organizes the response around it."},{"evidence":"To begin with / Secondly / Lastly / To conclude","quality":"transitions","description":"It uses explicit discourse markers to connect paragraphs and signal progression through the argument."},{"evidence":"flexibility, access to faculty, accelerated courses","quality":"supporting points","description":"It develops the main claim with multiple distinct reasons rather than repeating the same idea."},{"evidence":"students who work or have families","quality":"audience awareness","description":"It shows more attention to the practical situation of the intended readers by relating ideas to students' lives."},{"evidence":"meet their deadlines and participate apropriately online","quality":"sentence control","description":"It has more instances of controlled sentence structure, especially in the concluding guidance."},{"evidence":"students want to make the right decisions in choosing classes","quality":"formal academic style","description":"It maintains a more appropriately informational, school-essay tone overall."}]}
